title: Cozy Basement Studio in Quiet Inglewood
description:
Welcome to your cozy studio suite in Nashville's quiet Inglewood neighborhood on the East Side! Relax in your private basement suite with separate entrance, fenced outdoor space, full bathroom, kitchenette, full-size bed, and sleeper sofa. 

Walk to parks or the bus stop or drive to downtown Nashville, Opryland, Five Points, Shelby Bottoms/Shelby Park, Germantown in 10-15 minutes. We're conveniently located to venues like Ascend, Bridgestone, Grand Old Opry & Nissan Stadium. NO EXTRA FEES

The space
This studio suite has an open living and sleeping area, along with a private bathroom, and a fully appointed kitchenette with single serve coffee maker, toaster, tea kettle, and microwave.

Metro Nashville STRP #2022065602

Follow us on IG @TheBasementStudioNashville for more photos and trip ideas!

Other things to note
House rules include no smoking, no pets, no firearms, quiet hours enforced between 10pm and 7am, no unregistered overnight guests, and no parties.
